seeds.note: S_selftest only. No stream draws an instance; all instances are archived.

instance_sets.U62: Every F-S3 test-target record of RUN-CERTBIN-3b7e05 with D = 4, stratum "unsat" and one_in_R false. Expected exactly 62 (all also have one_in_R false at D = 3).
instance_sets.S62: The 62 lowest-idx F-S3 test targets with stratum "sat" (non-degenerate).
instance_sets.C20: The 20 lowest-idx F-S3 test targets with stratum "unsat" and one_in_R true at D = 4 (monotonicity and baseline control).
instance_sets.N-AFF62: The 62 lowest-idx non-degenerate F-AFF-1 test targets with stratum "unsat" (archived one_in_R false at D = 4 is expected for all; F-AFF-1 had 0/115). Instance = A0 + sum_j r_j Aj from the archived A0_hex/Aj_hex.
instance_sets.N-F262: The 62 lowest-idx F-NULLF2 test targets with stratum "unsat" (0/138 at D = 4). Instance = the archived per-target E_hex.

missing_field_rule: If p1-instances.json.gz lacks a needed field (A0_hex, Aj_hex or E_hex), the executor regenerates it from the frozen EXP-CERTBIN-4e92d7 seed with numpy 2.4.6 (DEC-20260923-4d7a19 R-2) and requires per-idx agreement of s and stratum with the archived records. Any disagreement is a STOP.
closures_run: M_4: baseline only (C-BASE), on every instance set

W_5: ONLY on (i) every U62 instance refuted by neither W_4 nor M_5; (ii) the 10 lowest-idx S62 instances (PS1 at W_5); (iii) up to the 10 lowest-idx instances of each null set refuted by neither W_4 nor M_5. Per-instance watchdog 14,400 s; an expiry labels that instance UNDETERMINED(budget) for W_5, never "not refuted".

W_5.U62: every instance refuted by neither W_4 nor M_5 (verified or reported)
W_5.N-AFF62: up to the 10 lowest-idx instances refuted by neither W_4 nor M_5
W_5.N-F262: up to the 10 lowest-idx instances refuted by neither W_4 nor M_5

w5_selection_note: W_5 residual selection uses the closure outputs of phases 2-3 as REPORTED by the engine (the verifier runs after all closures, phase 6).
c_det_instances: 10 lowest-idx U62 and 5 lowest-idx S62: M_5 (rank_5, 1 in R_5) and W_4 (dim, iterations, 1 in W_4)
phases: 1 instance-set selection and C-ORACLE; C-BASE (M_3, M_4)
3 M_5 on U62, S62 and the null sets
4 W_5 on the residual, the 10 S62 controls and the null residuals
6 verifier (separate process; verify_command), C-VERIFIER negative controls
7 aggregation, decision rules, run report (--resume after phase 6)
outputs: inputs.json (input sha256 and the C-SRC comparison)
instance-sets.json (U62, S62, C20, N-AFF62, N-F262 by idx, with archived fields)
closures.jsonl.gz (per instance and closure; rank, "1 in X", W_D iterations and dims, labels)
instrument-checks.json (every C-* with pass/fail and violating instances)
decision-rules.json (RC1-DR-1..7 with inputs, including both RC1-DR-2 labels)
manifest.yaml, raw-result.json, command.txt, environment.json, stdout.log, stderr.log
run-report.md: each RC1-DR verdict; which of PA-1..PA-3 held, failed or were not evaluable; which parts (a)-(d) of the coordinator_prior were overturned; the claim tier and scope statement verbatim.
